metadata.description: Generic analysis plugin for dashboards that implement the assay profile (org.xmind.assay-profile). Rules only — no addresses, no metric definitions. When a number still looks wrong after the definitions check, it traces the cause in the dashboard's linked code repos and, with the user's go-ahead and repo access, follows up with an issue or PR (an existing one first) instead of stopping at a report.

plugins.name: assay
plugins.description: Analyze product metrics from any assay-profile compatible dashboard MCP server; trace numbers that still look wrong after the definitions check to the linked code repos and, with the user's go-ahead and repo access, follow up with an issue or PR (an existing one first). 数据看板分析，数字不对就溯源跟进。
